video_title: Cameron Boozer and Karim Lopez Join The Chris Vernon Show

quotes.speaker: Cameron Boozer
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer on his decision to join the Memphis Grizzlies
quotes.excerpt: I came, talked to coach, watched the film, spent time with Zach and just being around the organization
quotes.quote: I came, talked to coach, watched the film, spent time with Zach and just being around the organization, you could see how well run it was and how smart the coach was and everything. It was great vibes here for sure.

quotes.speaker: Karim Lopez
quotes.summary_phrase: Karim Lopez on his connection to the Grizzlies' system
quotes.excerpt: They have similar systems and similar ways they want to play, so that is something that is going to help me
quotes.quote: They have similar systems and similar ways they want to play, so that is something that is going to help me in transition, just fitting in with the team.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Boozer
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer on his approach to winning basketball
quotes.excerpt: I don't cheat the game, I show up at work, I have high energy
quotes.quote: I don't cheat the game, I show up at work, I have high energy and I think it starts with great coaching. I have always been surrounded by great coaches and players who really want to buy in and win. For me, I was always the best player on my team doing the right things, and it just trickles down and everyone starts doing the right things. People talk about my winning, but you can't do that without a team.

quotes.speaker: Karim Lopez
quotes.summary_phrase: Karim Lopez on his role as a winning player
quotes.excerpt: I am just a winning player, someone that is going to contribute in winning, a competitor
quotes.quote: I am just a winning player, someone that is going to contribute in winning, a competitor, a high IQ player, someone that is going to make play the right way, and the first thing I said is just contribute to winning.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Boozer
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer on his leadership and winning mentality
quotes.excerpt: I want to be someone who when you talk about me, you talk about me being a winner
quotes.quote: I want to be someone who is a winner, someone who makes other guys around him better. I want to be a leader, but first and foremost I want to be someone who when you talk about me, you talk about me being a winner. I want to be someone who comes to Memphis and we win a lot of games. I want to be a big driving factor in that as well, so that is the main thing I want people to talk about me for.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Boozer
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer on the Grizzlies' potential for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: We are a team who is going to really surprise people this year
quotes.quote: We are a team who is going to really surprise people this year. We are going to be shockingly good to people. I think people don't really understand that just because obviously it was kind of a rebuild, but you look at the players we have, the roster who we are bringing in this year, and I think we are going to have something pretty special.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Boozer
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer on his matchup against GG Jackson
quotes.excerpt: I played him top 100 camp, I was a freshman, he was number one player in the country
quotes.quote: I played him top 100 camp, I was a freshman, he was number one player in the country at the time. That was right before he reclassed up and he was just a tough matchup.
